subject: English
question_text: Make five sentences using parts of sentences from each column of the table below. 1  5 =
stimulus: Character a man without character It influences a mental or moral nature If character be lost, everything is lost Everybody hates the crown of a man Environment one's character
guide_solution: (a) Character is a mental or moral nature. (b) It is the crown of a man. (c) If character is lost, everything is lost. (d) Everybody hates a man without character. (e) Environment influences one's character.
